_doc: Config for scripts/sync_records.py — the Round-3 'triggers all' intake. Folder/sheet ids from the project's Drive folder; spec = Görüntü Alma Kılavuzu v7 EK-2.
_operators_doc: A SEED, not a whitelist. sync_records.resolve_operators() unions this with every subfolder of the Drive goruntuler folder — that layout is the real roster, so a new operator needs no edit here. Names are kept in the seed after their Drive folder goes away, so existing rows still validate; the seed is also the offline fallback when Drive is unreachable.
